# 641. Design Circular Deque

## Solution 1

```python
class MyCircularDeque(object):

    def __init__(self, k):
        """
        :type k: int
        """
        self.elements = [0 for _ in range(k + 1)]
        self.front = self.rear = 0


    def insertFront(self, value):
        """
        :type value: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        if self.isFull():
            return False
        self.front = (self.front - 1) % len(self.elements)
        self.elements[self.front] = value
        return True


    def insertLast(self, value):
        """
        :type value: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        if self.isFull():
            return False
        self.elements[self.rear] = value
        self.rear = (self.rear + 1) % len(self.elements)
        return True


    def deleteFront(self):
        """
        :rtype: bool
        """
        if self.isEmpty():
            return False
        self.front = (self.front + 1) % len(self.elements)
        return True


    def deleteLast(self):
        """
        :rtype: bool
        """
        if self.isEmpty():
            return False
        self.rear = (self.rear - 1) % len(self.elements)
        return True


    def getFront(self):
        """
        :rtype: int
        """
        if self.isEmpty():
            return -1
        return self.elements[self.front]


    def getRear(self):
        """
        :rtype: int
        """
        if self.isEmpty():
            return -1
        return self.elements[(self.rear - 1) % len(self.elements)]


    def isEmpty(self):
        """
        :rtype: bool
        """
        return self.front == self.rear


    def isFull(self):
        """
        :rtype: bool
        """
        return (self.rear + 1) % len(self.elements) == self.front


# Your MyCircularDeque object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = MyCircularDeque(k)

# param_2 = obj.insertLast(value)
# param_3 = obj.deleteFront()
# param_4 = obj.deleteLast()
# param_5 = obj.getFront()
# param_6 = obj.getRear()
# param_7 = obj.isEmpty()
# param_8 = obj.isFull()
```
